alerts.title: Alerts & Incident Mode
alerts.intro: E-mail, webhook and Slack alerts for event drops, vendor outages, credential expiry, consent errors, queue lag and unusual conversion deviations — evaluated every minute from measured data. Incident Mode pauses one destination or one environment while everything else keeps running. Every action is audited.
alerts.readOnly: Your role can view this page; changing channels, rules and Incident Mode needs the organization or integrations permission.
alerts.migrationMissingText: The alert tables (migration 0013) are not applied to this database. Incident Mode works; channels, rules and history are unavailable until the migration runs.

event_drop.label: Event drop
event_drop.description: Accepted events of the last hours fall below the average of the same window over the last four weeks.

vendor_outage.label: Vendor outage
vendor_outage.description: A destination rejects deliveries (error rate over the 24 h window) or is in error state.

credential_expiry.label: Credential expiry
credential_expiry.description: A stored credential expires soon or has expired; an OAuth connection is no longer connected.

consent_errors.label: Consent errors
consent_errors.description: Too many events are blocked for missing or denied consent.

queue_lag.label: Queue lag
queue_lag.description: The oldest queued event of a destination has waited longer than allowed.

conversion_anomaly.label: Conversion anomaly
conversion_anomaly.description: Conversions deviate from the four-week baseline in either direction.

incident.title: Incident Mode
incident.intro: Stop one flow without stopping the rest: pause a single destination (events keep being collected and delivered elsewhere) or pause the browser tracking of one environment by publishing a signed configuration with the kill switch on. Server-side events, the other environments and every destination continue.
incident.switchSiteHint: Change the site in the workspace switcher.
incident.noSiteText: Create a site first — destinations and environments belong to a site.
incident.readOnly: Pausing and resuming needs the integrations permission (destinations) and the kill-switch permission (environments).

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.emptyText: Connect a destination first. Draft destinations are not shown here.
destinations.pauseText: Events keep being collected and delivered to every other destination. Events for this destination are skipped while it is paused — they are not queued for later. You can resume at any time. The action is audited.
destinations.resumeText: Track runs a credential check first. Deliveries resume only if the vendor accepts the stored credentials; otherwise the destination stays disconnected and the reason is shown here.
destinations.notResumed: Not resumed: the credential check failed.

environments.title: Environments (config kill switch)
environments.signingMissing: The configuration signing key is not configured on this server; the environment kill switch cannot publish a version.
environments.pauseText: Track publishes a new signed configuration version with the kill switch on. Browsers stop sending events for this environment with their next configuration fetch (within about a minute); server-side events, other environments and every destination keep running. The open draft is not touched. You can resume at any time. The action is audited.
environments.resumeText: Track publishes a new signed configuration version with the kill switch off, derived from the live version. Browsers resume with their next configuration fetch.
environments.paused: Kill switch published as v{version}. Browser tracking pauses with the next configuration fetch.

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.intro: Where alerts are delivered. E-mail addresses are stored as entered; webhook and Slack URLs and the webhook signing secret are encrypted and never shown again.
channels.emptyText: Add an e-mail address, a webhook or a Slack incoming webhook. Rules only notify through channels; without one, alerts appear in the history only.
channels.caption: Notification channels with type, target, language, status and the last test result

channels.deleteText: Rules that use this channel keep running without it. Past deliveries stay in the history. This cannot be undone.

kindHint.email: Plain-text e-mail in the language you choose.
kindHint.webhook: HTTPS POST with a JSON body; with a secret, every request carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Track-Signature header (t=…,n=…,v1=…).
kindHint.slack: Slack incoming webhook (hooks.slack.com) with Block Kit blocks.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.intro: What to watch, for which site, with which thresholds and through which channels. Rules are evaluated every minute by the worker; after a notification a rule stays quiet for its cooldown.
rules.emptyText: Add a rule for event drops, vendor outages, credential expiry, consent errors, queue lag or conversion anomalies. Nothing is alerted until a rule exists.
rules.caption: Alert rules with kind, scope, condition, channels, status and last evaluation
rules.neverEvaluated: Not evaluated yet — the worker job runs every minute.
rules.deleteText: Past alerts of this rule stay in the history. This cannot be undone.

form.kindFixed: The kind of an existing rule cannot change; add a new rule instead.
form.name: Name
form.channelsHint: Without a channel the alert is recorded in the history only.
form.noChannels: No channels yet — add one above.
form.cooldownHint: After a notification the rule stays quiet for this long per subject ({min}–{max}).

preview.event_drop: Alert when the accepted events of the last {windowMinutes} minutes are at least {dropPercent} % below the average of the same window over the last four weeks — only when that average is at least {minBaseline} events.
preview.vendor_outage: Alert when a destination rejected at least {errorRatePercent} % of at least {minAttempts} delivery attempts in the last 24 hours, or is in error state.
preview.credential_expiry: Alert when a credential expires within {daysBefore} days or has expired, or an OAuth connection is no longer connected.
preview.consent_errors: Alert when at least {errorRatePercent} % of the events received in the last {windowMinutes} minutes were blocked for consent reasons — only after at least {minEvents} events.
preview.queue_lag: Alert when the oldest queued event of a destination has waited longer than {lagSeconds} seconds ({lagMinutes} minutes).
preview.conversion_anomaly: Alert when the conversions of the last {windowMinutes} minutes deviate by at least {deviationPercent} % from the average of the same window over the last four weeks — only when that average is at least {minBaseline} conversions.

history.title: Alert history
history.intro: Every triggered alert with severity, the measured facts behind it, the delivery per channel and its resolution. Alerts resolve on their own when the condition clears, or by hand.
history.emptyText: Nothing has triggered. Alerts appear here once a rule's condition is met — the worker evaluates every minute.
history.emptyFilteredText: Reset the filters to see every alert.
history.openCount: {count, plural, =0 {no open alerts} one {# open alert} other {# open alerts}}
history.caption: Alert history with severity, facts, delivery outcome and resolution
